contents.text: Left-click a slot to edit it. Hold an item to use it as the icon. The bottom-right book is Tools, not part of the menu.

Players open the published list with /trigger guikit.open. Menus are stored in the world, so /reload does not wipe them. Another player cannot open your chest. Click rules (confirm, cooldown, vip/member/staff tag) are on the slot dialog.
